title: When Does It Leave? indul and érkezik

sections.content: indul ('to depart') and érkezik ('to arrive') describe the start and end of a journey. They're introduced by the question word mikor ('when').
érkezik ends in -ik, marking it as an ik-verb -- its first-person singular is érkezem, not 'érkezek'. Watch for this pattern with other -ik verbs, like lakik and dolgozik.
